newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stocks end lower after early gains.
newsitem.headline: KL stocks end lower after early gains.

text.p: Kuala Lumpur shares closed lower after profit-taking wiped out early gains, but analysts said it was a temporary setback as market sentiment remains positive.
"The market is only taking a breather," said Chung Tin Fah, research manager at brokerage OSK & Partners. "The uptrend is still intact. Volume is still there."
The Composite Index of key 100 stocks ended down 5.93 points at 1,259.44 after hitting an early high of 1,270.79.
The market had earlier shrugged off fears about possible higher U.S. interest rates.
